changes.comment: Each ai-assist wire's schema table now states the numeric-enum and untyped-schema shapes: a numeric or boolean enum passes on OpenAI, xAI and both Anthropic wires and folds into the description on Gemini and unverified servers; a schema with no type (JsonSchema.anyValue, {}) passes on Anthropic tools and is refused elsewhere, failing the client-tool request before it is sent with the tool and path named, and making a structured-output request a capability mismatch under onUnsupported. The internal tool formatters (toResponsesApiTools, toAnthropicTools, toGeminiTools) return a Result. New AiAssist.clientToolSchemaKeywords(descriptor, { model, endpoint }) returns the keyword-capability table a descriptor's client-tool wire uses, for adaptMcpTools' schemaKeywords option.
